import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from collections import defaultdict
import os

# Set path
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "en_train.csv"))
test = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "en_test_2.csv"))
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "en_sample_submission_2.csv"))

# Build mapping: for each 'before', choose the most frequent 'after'
# Resolve ties by lexicographically smallest (or any deterministic choice)
before_to_after = {}
for group in train.groupby("before")["after"]:
    vals = group[1]
    counts = vals.value_counts()
    max_count = counts.max()
    candidates = counts[counts == max_count].index.tolist()
    # Tie-breaking: pick smallest string lexicographically
    chosen = min(candidates)
    before_to_after[group[0]] = chosen

# Holdout validation: split train 90/10
np.random.seed(42)
train_size = int(0.9 * len(train))
perm = np.random.permutation(len(train))
train_idx, val_idx = perm[:train_size], perm[train_size:]

train_val = train.iloc[train_idx]
val_df = train.iloc[val_idx]

# Rebuild mapping on train part only (to avoid leakage)
before_to_after_val = {}
for group in train_val.groupby("before")["after"]:
    vals = group[1]
    counts = vals.value_counts()
    max_count = counts.max()
    candidates = counts[counts == max_count].index.tolist()
    chosen = min(candidates)
    before_to_after_val[group[0]] = chosen

# Validate on held-out set
val_preds = []
val_true = []
for row in val_df.itertuples(index=False):
    before = row.before
    after_true = row.after
    after_pred = before_to_after_val.get(before)
    if after_pred is None:
        # Fallback: if unseen, use original token or heuristics
        # Simple heuristic: for digits-only, keep as-is (common fallback)
        # But test shows many PUNCT/PLAIN are exact in test, so fallback to before
        after_pred = before
    val_preds.append(after_pred)
    val_true.append(after_true)

accuracy = sum(p == t for p, t in zip(val_preds, val_true)) / len(val_true)
print(f"Validation accuracy: {accuracy:.6f}")

# Prepare test predictions
test_preds = []
for row in test.itertuples(index=False):
    before = row.before
    after_pred = before_to_after.get(before)
    if after_pred is None:
        after_pred = before  # fallback
    test_preds.append(after_pred)

# Build submission dataframe (use sample_sub id column as template)
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": sample_sub["id"].values, "after": test_preds})

# Ensure directory exists
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Save submission
submission.to_csv(os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv"), index=False)

print(f"Submission saved to {SUBMISSION_DIR}/submission.csv")
